bind_sources.doc: A writable field of a Rust store (#[svelters::store]) bound to a native prop: linked in the host, both ways, with no JS per change.

framework: skelter (svelters-skelter; retained tree, taffy layout, wgpu compositor)

ids.scheme: skelter-core FNV-1a-32 of (declaring kind, member, type)

checked.provenance: svelters-skelter: <action> writes checked into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `activate` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

Action.doc: A menu item: plain, a check item (`checkable`) or a radio item (`group`), with an optional `shortcut`. AccessKit role Button, CheckBox or RadioButton.

checkable.doc: A check item: picking it toggles `checked`.

checked.doc: Check or radio state; picking a check item toggles it, picking a radio item sets it.

group.doc: A radio item: the actions of one parent with the same group form an exclusive set; picking one checks it and unchecks the others (each announced).

shortcut.doc: Keyboard accelerator such as `Ctrl+O`, `Ctrl+Shift+S` or `F5`: shown right-aligned and active while the menu's owner (menu-bar, menu-button, context-menu) is drawn. Modifiers: `Ctrl`, `Shift`, `Alt`, `Cmd` (macOS command), `Primary` (Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere); keys are egui `Key` names. An unknown key is an error.

activate.doc: The user picked it (click, Enter, or its shortcut); carries `checked` after the pick.
activate.name: activate

hover.doc: It became the open menu's current row (the pointer or the arrow keys; QAction `hovered`). Svelters' own menus only (OW3).
hover.name: hover

toggled.doc: The user changed `checked` (a check item, or a radio item turned on or off by a pick); carries the new state.
toggled.name: toggled

Anchor.doc: An inline link: the `link` colour, underlined on hover (DESIGN R18), the pointer cursor (R10); focusable, activated by click, Enter or Space.

href.doc: The link target. Without an `onclicked` handler a click opens it (as `hyperlink`'s `url`); with one, only the handler runs.

clicked.doc: The link was activated (click, or Enter/Space while it has keyboard focus).
clicked.name: clicked

Bold.doc: Bold inline text (`font-weight: 700` from the theme's base sheet).

Box.doc: A flexbox container laid out by taffy; draws nothing itself.

column-gap.doc: Space between columns in points; null to use `gap`.

flex-wrap.doc: Whether children wrap onto more lines.

focus-scope.doc: `contain`: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside while focus is in it; `dialog`: also takes focus when it appears (`autofocus` node, else the first) and gives it back to the opener when it goes away.

gap.doc: Space between children on both axes, in points (row-gap and column-gap override it).

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

row-gap.doc: Space between rows in points; null to use `gap`.

cancel.doc: Escape activates it while focus is in its focus scope (or root).

default.doc: Enter activates it while focus is in its focus scope (or root) and the focused node does not take Enter itself.

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws the button background and border.

icon.doc:
An icon before the caption: an icon key (`name` in the `icons` family, or `family:name`).
Its size, place and visibility are CSS on `::part(icon)` (P3).

repeat.doc:
Held down, it activates again and again (`clicked` after 300 ms, then every 100 ms;
QAbstractButton `autoRepeat`).

selected.doc: Drawn as selected (a toggle look); clicking does not change it.

press.doc: The primary button went down on it (QAbstractButton `pressed`).
press.name: press

release.doc: It came up again, over the button or not (`released`).
release.name: release

checked.provenance: svelters-skelter: <checkbox> writes checked into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

indeterminate.provenance: svelters-skelter: <checkbox> writes indeterminate into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

Checkbox.doc: A check box with a caption.

icon.doc: An icon before the caption (a key, or `family:name`).

indeterminate.doc:
WIDGET-PARITY §2.2: partially checked (`bind:indeterminate`), shown as a dash. The app
writes it; a click clears it and checks the box (Qt, GTK).

tristate.doc: The user cycles unchecked → checked → indeterminate (Qt's tristate).

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

Code.doc: Inline code: the monospace font on the field fill (theme's base sheet).

open.provenance: svelters-skelter: <collapsing-header> writes open into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

CollapsingHeader.doc: A clickable header with a caret; its children (a flex box, indented) are shown and laid out only while `open`.

accordion.doc: The group of sibling headers of which one is open at a time (QToolBox); empty: none.

icon.doc: An icon before the caption (a key, or `family:name`).

open.doc: Shows the children; a click on the header (or Enter/Space on it) toggles it.

text.doc: The header's caption (also its accessible name).

changed.doc: The user opened or closed it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

open.provenance: svelters-skelter: <combo-box> writes open into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

selected.provenance: svelters-skelter: <combo-box> writes selected into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

ComboBox.doc: A drop-down list: shows the selected option, picks one from a popup. Name it with `accessible-name` (it has no caption).

hint-text.doc: Shown while `selected` is out of range.

max-visible.doc: Rows shown before the list scrolls (QComboBox `maxVisibleItems`).

open.doc:
The list is open; the user opening or closing it changes it, setting it opens or closes it
(QComboBox `showPopup`/`hidePopup`).

options.doc: The choices, in order (the popup's rows).

selected.doc: Index of the chosen option; picking a row changes it. Out of range shows no text.

wheel.doc: The wheel over the closed select changes the pick: `off` (default), `hover`, `focused`.

activate.doc: The user picked an option, the same one or not (QComboBox `activated`); carries its index.
activate.name: activate

changed.doc: The user picked a row; carries its index.
changed.name: changed

commit.doc: A pick finished the edit (§2.4); carries the index.
commit.name: commit

highlight.doc: The current row of the open list moved (keyboard or pointer; `highlighted`).
highlight.name: highlight

ContextMenu.doc: A menu that attaches to the element it is declared in and opens at the pointer on a secondary click on it (the innermost owner wins). `popup` opens it below its owner. The shortcuts of its actions are active while the owner is drawn.

popup.doc: Opens it (a context menu below its owner).

checked.provenance: svelters-skelter: <frame> writes checked into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

Frame.doc: A flex box drawn inside an egui frame (background, border, rounding, inner margin), with an optional caption.

checkable.doc:
WIDGET-PARITY §2.16 (QGroupBox `checkable`): a check before the caption; unchecked
disables the content.

frame-style.doc: The egui frame drawn around the content: `egui::Frame::group`, `canvas`, `window`, `menu`, `popup`, `side_top_panel` (`panel`), or no chrome (`none`). Its inner margin adds to `padding`.

label.doc: A caption above the content (GTK's `Gtk.Frame:label`); empty for none.

changed.doc: The user toggled the check; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

Grid.doc: A CSS grid container laid out by taffy: children fill the cells row by row (auto-placement); draws nothing itself.

align-items.doc: Vertical alignment of each child in its cell.

column-gap.doc: Space between columns in points; null to use `gap`.

gap.doc: Space between rows and between columns, in points (row-gap and column-gap override it).

grid-template-columns.doc: The column tracks, CSS syntax: `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `<n>fr`, `<n>px` (or a bare number: points), `<n>%`, `minmax(a, b)`, `fit-content(<len>)`, `repeat(<n>, tracks)`. Rows are implicit (`auto`). The default is a form: a label column and a field column.

justify-items.doc: Horizontal alignment of each child in its cell.

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

row-gap.doc: Space between rows in points; null to use `gap`.

Hyperlink.doc: A link: text that opens `url` when clicked (AccessKit role `Link`).

new-tab.doc: Asks for a new browser tab (`OpenUrl::new_tab`). A middle click always does.

text.doc: The link text; the url when empty.

url.doc: Opened on a click (`Context::open_url`: eframe opens the browser, an embedder reads `PlatformOutput::commands`); empty for none.

clicked.doc: Pressed and released (before the url opens).
clicked.name: clicked

Icon.doc: An icon from the icon registry by key (ICR1), or a glyph from an icon font the embedder registered (SVP6), by name or as text. With `frame` it is an icon button. Its accessible name is `accessible-name`, else `tooltip`, else `name`.

family.doc: The registered font family (`egui::FontFamily::Name`) holding the glyphs; empty for the proportional family. A family with no fonts, a name not in its table or a glyph no font has draws an outlined placeholder box (`svelters_egui::fonts::FontWarning`).

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws it as a button (an icon button: role `Button`, takes focus).

glyph.doc: The glyph itself (text), when `name` is empty or not in the table.

name.doc: An icon registry key (`file.save`, `debug.step-over`; `svelters_egui::icons`) when `family` is `icons` and the key is registered: drawn from its SVG masters (optical size by physical pixels), tinted by CSS `color`, with the `--icon-subject`/`--icon-accent`/`--icon-badge` colour slots. Otherwise the glyph's name in the family's name table (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_icons`). Also the default accessible name.

selected.doc: With `frame`: drawn as selected (a toggle look).

size.doc: Font size in points; null for the body size (16 for a registry icon).

source.doc: An image instead of the glyph: an `asset://` ref (an imported SVG or PNG), a file path or any uri an egui loader serves. Measured `size` (else the body size) square and fitted inside; when it does not load the placeholder box is drawn.

tint.doc: With `source`: tints the image with the text colour (SVG `currentColor` icons render white, then tint like a glyph); false keeps its own colours.

Image.doc: A picture from `source`, at its own size unless `width`/`height` say otherwise. AccessKit role `Image`, named by `accessible-name` or `tooltip`.

fit.doc: How the image fills its rect (CSS `object-fit`): `contain` keeps the aspect ratio inside it, `cover` fills it and crops, `fill` stretches, `none` keeps the image's size, `scale-down` is the smaller of `none` and `contain`.

source.doc: What to show: a file path, a `file://` uri, or any uri an egui loader serves (`bytes://` from `Context::include_bytes`, `http(s)://` with egui_extras' loaders). PNG decodes built in.

clicked.doc: Pressed and released on it (it senses clicks only while listened).
clicked.name: clicked

Italic.doc: Italic inline text (`font-style: italic` from the theme's base sheet).

selection-end.provenance: svelters-skelter: <label> writes selection-end into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

selection-start.provenance: svelters-skelter: <label> writes selection-start into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

Label.doc: Static text; with inline run children (`<b>`, `<i>`, `<code>`, `<a>`, `<span>`) one paragraph of styled runs (RT2).

elide.doc: WG6 QW13: cut one line with `…` to the width: `none`, `start`, `middle`, `end`.

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

for.doc: The `anchor` of the control this label names (Qt's buddy): a click focuses it.

selectable.doc: The text can be selected and copied.

selection-end.doc: The selection's end, in chars (`bind:`); a negative end is the end of the text.

selection-start.doc: The selection's start, in chars of the shown text (`bind:`).

wrap-mode.doc: What a line longer than the width does (`egui::TextWrapMode`).

copy.doc: Ctrl/Cmd+C on a focused selectable label: the selected text, for the host's clipboard.
copy.name: copy

MenuEntry.doc: Common properties of the menu entries (`menu`, `action`, `menu-separator`, `context-menu`): drawn inside a menu, never laid out by taffy.

accessible-name.doc: AccessKit name; the label by default.

anchor.doc: A name unique in its embedded root (AccessKit author id, `Embed::anchor_rect`).

anchor-scope.doc: Set by the runtime on the top nodes of a keyed `{#each}` item (its keys, U+001F-separated): scopes the egui id of an `anchor` inside it. Not for apps to set.

enabled.doc: Can be picked when true; drawn greyed out otherwise.

source-loc.doc: Set by the runtime in dev builds: where the node was declared (`file#offset`, then the component call sites around it, U+001F-separated). Not for apps to set.

visible.doc: Shown in its menu when true.

ProgressBar.doc: A horizontal bar filled to `fraction`, as wide as its rect.

animate.doc: Animates the bar and shows a spinner in it (busy look; repaints while shown).

format.doc:
The label's text when `text` is empty: `%p` percent, `%v` value, `%m` maximum (`%%` a
percent sign); shown when set or with `show-percentage` (`%p%`).

indeterminate.doc: Busy, as `animate` (and `:indeterminate`); also when `value` is set and `min == max`.

inverted.doc: Fills from the end (right, or top when vertical) instead.

show-percentage.doc: Shows the percentage inside the bar when `text` is empty.

text.doc: Text inside the bar; empty for none.

value.doc: WIDGET-PARITY §2.9: the value in `min..max`, the alternative to `fraction` (Qt's form).

checked.provenance: svelters-skelter: <radio-button> writes checked into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

group.provenance: svelters-skelter: <radio-button> writes group into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 1); a JS write is never echoed

RadioButton.doc: One choice of several. Siblings are exclusive: a click checks it and unchecks the other radio buttons of the same parent. Bind `checked` per button, or `group` on every button with a `value` each.

checked.doc: Chosen. A click checks it and unchecks its sibling radio buttons (Qt's auto-exclusive siblings); it never unchecks itself. With `value`, it follows `group == value`.

group.doc: The group's chosen value (`bind:group={choice}` on every button of the group, each with its own `value`). A click sets it on this button and its siblings.

icon.doc: WIDGET-PARITY §2.3: an icon before the caption (a key, or `family:name`).

value.doc: What this button stands for in its group: a click writes it into `group`.

changed.doc: The user's click changed it (or a sibling's click unchecked it); carries the new state and group value.
changed.name: changed

Run.doc: Common properties of the inline runs (`span`, `b`, `i`, `code`, `a`): text inside a `label`, laid out with the label's other runs as one paragraph, never by taffy.

accessible-name.doc: AccessKit name of an `a` run's link (defaults to its text); other runs are read as part of their label's text.

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900) of this run and the runs in it; 0 (the default) inherits the enclosing run's or label's weight. `b` has 700 from the theme's base sheet.

text.doc: The run's own text, before its child runs (its text children fold into it).

scroll-x.provenance: svelters-skelter: <scroll-area> writes scroll-x into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

scroll-y.provenance: svelters-skelter: <scroll-area> writes scroll-y into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 1); a JS write is never echoed

ScrollArea.doc: A flex box whose content scrolls when it overflows the area's size (taffy `overflow: scroll`); give it a size or let flex-grow size it.

direction.doc: The axes that scroll (taffy `overflow: scroll` on them).

scroll-x.doc: Horizontal offset in points; scrolling changes it, and a write scrolls (clamped to the content).

scroll-y.doc: Vertical offset in points; scrolling changes it, and a write scrolls (clamped to the content).

changed.doc: The user scrolled (or a write was clamped); carries the new offsets.
changed.name: changed

Separator.doc: A thin line between items; fills its rect along its orientation.

orientation.doc: A horizontal line (in a column) or a vertical one (in a row).

Sides.doc: A row with its first child at the start and its second at the end (wrap several items in a `box`); with more children, the space is shared between them.

align-items.doc: Cross-axis alignment of the two sides (`center` is egui's look).

gap.doc: Minimum space between the two sides, in points.

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

value.provenance: svelters-skelter: <slider> writes value into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

Slider.doc: A horizontal slider with an optional value box.

commit.doc: Commit-only mode (Qt `tracking=false`): `value` moves at the release, not while dragging.

marks.doc:
Marks on the rail, drawn as ticks (with labels) instead of the `tick-interval` ticks:
values separated by commas, each optionally `value:label` (`"0:Low, 50, 100:High"`).

page-step.doc: PageUp/PageDown and `track-click="page"` move this much (Qt `pageStep`); 0 for ten steps.

show-value.doc: Shows the value box next to the slider.

snap-to-marks.doc: Dragging snaps to the nearest mark.

track-click.doc: A press on the track off the thumb: `jump` there (default) or `page` toward it.

value.doc: The value; dragging or the arrow keys change it.

changed.doc: The user moved it; carries the new value.
changed.name: changed

drag-started.doc: A drag on the slider began.
drag-started.name: drag-started

drag-stopped.doc: A drag on the slider ended.
drag-stopped.name: drag-stopped

Span.doc: An inline run of text in a `label`, styled by CSS (`label span.cls`). Bare text in a rich label becomes anonymous spans.

size.doc: Diameter in points; null for the row height (`interact_size.y`).

spinning.doc: Spins (and repaints while shown); false keeps its space empty.

Stack.doc: Shows one of its children (GTK's `stack`, Qt's `stacked-widget`): the one anchored `visible-child-name`, else the one at `visible-index`. The others are neither drawn nor hit.

homogeneous.doc: Sized to the largest child (GTK's `hhomogeneous`/`vhomogeneous`); false: to the visible child.

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

visible-child-name.doc: Shows the child whose `anchor` is this name (GTK's `visible-child-name`; the child names itself with `anchor`). Empty: `visible-index` decides.

visible-index.doc: Shows the child at this index when `visible-child-name` is empty or names no child (Qt's `current-index`).

active.provenance: svelters-skelter: <switch> writes active into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

Switch.doc: An on/off switch with a sliding knob (GTK's `switch`; WinUI's `toggle-switch`).

active.doc: On; a click or Space toggles it.

text.doc: Caption after the switch (also its accessible name).

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

current.provenance: svelters-skelter: <table> writes current into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

current-column.provenance: svelters-skelter: <table> writes current-column into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

header-state.provenance: svelters-skelter: <table> writes header-state into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

hidden-columns.provenance: svelters-skelter: <table> writes hidden-columns into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

selected.provenance: svelters-skelter: <table> writes selected into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

sort-column.provenance: svelters-skelter: <table> writes sort-column into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

sort-order.provenance: svelters-skelter: <table> writes sort-order into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

Table.doc: A virtual table, svelters' own (OW5b): only the visible rows and columns are drawn, under a frozen header; rows, cells, header cells, sort arrows and resize edges are CSS parts. Its children are `table-column`s; its rows are a JS data window (`range` asks, `set-rows` answers), keyed by `set-ids`, or a Rust row model (LS2: `SceneMut::set_table_model`, sorted, filtered and tree rows expanded in Rust, no JS call per page). Keyboard navigation, type-ahead, keyed selection and cell editing (WG5a). Give it a size or let flex-grow size it.

clear-rows.doc: Drops the data window (every row draws empty until `set-rows`).

edit.doc: `edit(rowId, column)`: starts editing that cell (its column must be `editable`).

end-edit.doc: `end-edit(commit)`: ends the open edit; true commits (`commit`), false reverts.

fit-columns.doc: `fit-columns(column?)`: sizes that column (child index), or every resizable shown column, to its header and the cells in the data window (Qt `resizeColumnsToContents`); `column-resized` for each.

scroll-to-row.doc: `scroll-to-row(row)`: scrolls the row into view on the next frame.

set-ids.doc: `set-ids(ids, labels?)`: the id of every row by position (and the text type-ahead matches); the row count is then `ids.length`. Selection, cursor and edits follow ids across sorts and filters. null: ids are positions again.

set-rows.doc: `set-rows(first, rows)`: the data window, rows `first..first + rows.length`, each row a list of cell values (strings, numbers, booleans; null for empty). Replaces the previous window.

column-menu.doc: A right click on the header opens a menu that hides and shows the `hideable` columns (after `header-context`, unless prevented).

current.doc: The cursor row's id (keyboard focus inside the table), -1 for none.

current-column.doc: The cursor column (Left/Right move it; F2 and typing edit that cell).

header-state.doc: The header as JSON (Qt `saveState`): `{"widths":{name:points},"hidden":[name],"sort":{"column":name,"order":…}}`. The table writes it after the user resizes, hides or sorts; setting it restores them. Persist it with DX1's `uiState()` (`bind:header-state={ui.header}`): the table itself never writes files.

hidden-columns.doc: The hidden columns, by `name` (a column without one by its child index, `"2"`). The column menu changes it.

overscan.doc: Rows beyond the visible ones that `range` asks for on each side (data ready before it scrolls into view).

row-count.doc: Number of rows (the scroll extent). Rows without data yet are drawn empty.

row-height.doc: Height of every row (and of the header row), in points.

selected.doc: The selected row ids (`bind:selected`); clicks (Ctrl/Shift with `selection="multi"`) and the keyboard change it. Kept by id across `set-ids` (sorts, filters).

selection.doc: `single`, `multi` (Ctrl/Shift clicks and keys, ranges) or `none` (a cursor only).

sort-column.doc: The column (child index) the header shows sorted, -1 for none: then each column's own `sort` shows.

sortable.doc: A header click sorts on that column: `sort-column` becomes it, `sort-order` ascending, or flips when it already was (the rows are still sorted by JS, on `sort-changed`).

sticky-columns.doc: Number of leading columns that do not scroll horizontally.

stretch-last.doc: The last shown column fills the width the columns leave (Qt `stretchLastSection`).

striped.doc: Alternate rows get a faint background.

activated.doc: A row was double-clicked (a cell of a column that is not `editable`) or Enter pressed on the cursor row; carries its position.
activated.name: activated

changed.doc: The user changed the selection; carries the selected row ids (`bind:selected`).
changed.name: changed

column-resized.doc: The user resized a column (drag released, a double-click fit, `fit-columns`); carries the column and its width. The column's `width` is bindable.
column-resized.name: column-resized

columns-changed.doc: The column menu hid or showed a column; carries the hidden columns.
columns-changed.name: columns-changed

commit.doc: An edit is committed: row id, column index, the editor's value. Accept by returning nothing; reject with `e.result = 'reason'` (shown under the cell) or `e.preventDefault()`: the cell reverts.
commit.name: commit

copy.doc: Ctrl+C (Cmd+C) on the focused table; carries the selected row ids (the app copies the data it holds).
copy.name: copy

header-clicked.doc: A column header was clicked (sort on it in JS and set the column's `sort`).
header-clicked.name: header-clicked

header-context.doc: A right click on the header (Menu key on the focused table); carries the column under the pointer. Unless prevented, `column-menu` opens.
header-context.name: header-context

header-double-clicked.doc: A column header was double-clicked (not its resize edge); carries the column (child index).
header-double-clicked.name: header-double-clicked

header-state-changed.doc: The user resized, hid or sorted; carries the new `header-state` (save it).
header-state-changed.name: header-state-changed

range.doc: The rows the table needs data for changed: `first..=last` (the visible rows plus `overscan`); answer with `set-rows`.
range.name: range

row-toggled.doc: A tree row of a Rust model was expanded or collapsed (its expander, Right/Left); carries its id and whether it is expanded now.
row-toggled.name: row-toggled

selectionchange.doc: The user changed the selection; carries the selected row ids.
selectionchange.name: selectionchange

sort-changed.doc: A header click on a `sortable` table changed the sort; carries the column and the order (sort the rows in JS; a Rust model is sorted by the table).
sort-changed.name: sort-changed

TableColumn.doc: A column of its parent `table` (data only: not laid out or drawn as a node). Its `width` (Widget's, in points; null for 100; `min-width`/`max-width` clamp it) is the column's width; a user resize writes it (`bind:width`). `visible` false hides it; `tooltip` shows on its header; `table-column::part(header)` styles its header cell.

end-edit.doc: `end-edit(commit)`: ends this column's open edit; true commits, false reverts.

set-editor.doc: Runtime protocol: `set-editor(outlet)`, the realised editor snippet of this column (null drops it).

editable.doc: Its cells can be edited (F2, typing, double click); the editor is `editor`, else a text field.

editor.doc: The cell editor, a snippet taking the edit (`{ row, column, value (bindable), typed, commit(), cancel() }`); realised once and rebound per edit.

elide.doc: Where text too wide for a cell or the header is cut with `…` (`none`: clipped).

header-align.doc: Alignment of its header text (`auto`: its `align`).

hideable.doc: The column menu lists it (it can be hidden).

name.doc: Its name in `hidden-columns` and `header-state` (empty: its child index).

resizable.doc: Its right edge can be dragged (double-click: fit the content).

sort.doc: The sort arrow its header shows (the data is sorted by JS) while the table's `sort-column` is -1.

editor-bind.doc: Runtime protocol: an edit of this column's cell starts (the editor snippet's outlet is `set-editor`).
editor-bind.name: editor-bind

editor-unbind.doc: Runtime protocol: the edit ended; the editor stays realised for the next one.
editor-unbind.name: editor-unbind

editor-value.doc: Runtime protocol: the editor's value to commit (the handler sets `e.result`).
editor-value.name: editor-value

text.provenance: svelters-skelter: <text-edit> writes text into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

TextEdit.doc: A single- or multi-line text field.

request-focus.doc: Moves keyboard focus here on the next frame.

char-limit.doc: Maximum number of characters; 0 for none.

hint-text.doc: Shown while the text is empty; also the default accessible name.

multiline.doc: Several lines (`TextEdit::multiline`); Enter inserts a newline.

text.doc: The edited text; typing changes it.

changed.doc: The user edited the text; carries the new text (once per frame).
changed.name: changed

commit.doc: The user committed the text: Enter in a one-line field (also when a default button takes it), or losing focus after an edit since the last commit; carries the text.
commit.name: commit

submit.doc: Enter in a one-line field (also when a default button takes it); carries the text. Fires after `commit`.
submit.name: submit

checked.provenance: svelters-skelter: <toggle-button> writes checked into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

ToggleButton.doc: A button that stays pressed (`checked`). With `radio`, a row of them is a segmented control: a click checks one, the app unchecks the rest.

checked.doc: Pressed state; a click toggles it (with `radio`, a click only sets it).

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws the button background and border.

group.doc:
WIDGET-PARITY §2.1 (QButtonGroup): the sibling toggle buttons with the same `group` form an
exclusive set (checking one unchecks the others) and one Tab stop the arrow keys move in.

radio.doc: One of a segmented group: a click checks it and never unchecks it (`Ui::selectable_value`); AccessKit role `RadioButton`. The app unchecks the others.

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

clicked.doc: Pressed and released (also when a `radio` click left it checked).
clicked.name: clicked

current.provenance: svelters-skelter: <tree-view> writes current into the tree as native-owned state (architecture §4.5) and emits `changed` with it (arg 0); a JS write is never echoed

TreeView.doc: A virtualized tree: JS keeps the tree and flattens its visible rows into the list; children load when a node expands.

scrollTo.doc: `scrollTo(pos, hint?)`: scrolls the row into view; `hint`: `nearest` (default), `top`, `bottom`, `center`.

selection.doc: The selected ids, hidden ones included.

setNodes.doc: `setNodes(ids, levels, flags, labels, data)`: the tree facts of rows by id (flags: 1 expandable, 2 expanded; a level < 0 forgets the id).

setRow.doc: `setRow(row, widget)`: the content of row slot `row` (called from `setup`); null clears it.

setSelection.doc: `setSelection(ids)`: replaces the selection (single keeps the first); raises nothing.

splice.doc: `splice(pos, removed, ids)`: replaces `removed` rows at `pos` with `ids` (the visible rows, flattened).

current.doc: OW5a1b: the cursor's row id (`bind:current`), -1 for none. Setting it moves the cursor without selecting.

expand-on.doc: What toggles a row besides its twistie, Left/Right and AccessKit: `twistie` (nothing more; a double click activates), `click` (a click on the row), `double-click` (Qt's `expandsOnDoubleClick`).

indent.doc: Points per level; the disclosure triangle sits in the last one.

row-drag-type.doc: Non-empty: rows drag, as a payload of this type (their `data`) plus `text/plain` (their labels).

row-drop-types.doc: Non-empty: rows take drops of these types (WG4b patterns) and raise `drop-row`.

row-height.doc: The height a row is assumed to have before it is measured, and its minimum, in points.

selection.doc: `single`, `multi` (Shift ranges, Ctrl toggles), `toggle` (a click toggles, no modifier), `range` (one contiguous run, Shift extends); `none`: rows are not selectable.

uniform-rows.doc: OW5a1b: every row is `row-height` tall; rows are not measured (Qt `uniformRowHeights`).

activate.doc: The user activated the row at `pos` (double click, Enter).
activate.name: activate

bind.doc: Slot `row` now shows item `id` at `pos`; `gen` counts the binds of the slot.
bind.name: bind

collapse.doc: The user collapsed node `id` (disclosure click, Left): splice its children out.
collapse.name: collapse

copy.doc: Ctrl+C on the focused tree: copy the selected rows.
copy.name: copy

drop-row.doc: A drag was dropped `before`, `after` or `into` row `id` (-1: below the last row), as the entry of `type` it took.
drop-row.name: drop-row

expand.doc: The user expanded node `id` (disclosure click, Right): splice its children in.
expand.name: expand

row-clicked.doc: OW5a: a click on the row at `pos` (item `id`), after the selection moved.
row-clicked.name: row-clicked

row-context.doc: OW5a: a secondary click on the row at `pos` (item `id`): open its context menu. The selection follows first (an unselected row is selected, per platform Policy).
row-context.name: row-context

row-hovered.doc: OW5a1b: the pointer entered the row at `pos` (item `id`; Qt `entered`).
row-hovered.name: row-hovered

selection-changed.doc: The user changed the selection: read it with `selection()`.
selection-changed.name: selection-changed

setup.doc: Row slot `row` was created: give it content with `setRow`.
setup.name: setup

teardown.doc: Slot `row` is gone: release its widget.
teardown.name: teardown

Widget.doc: Common properties of everything placed in a window: state, tooltip, accessibility and its taffy item style.

scroll-into-view.doc: `scroll-into-view(align?)`: scrolls the scroll areas around the node so it is visible on the next frame, innermost first; `align` is `nearest` (the default: the least scrolling, keeping the area's `scroll-margin`) or `center`. Qt's `ensureWidgetVisible`, the DOM's `scrollIntoView`.

accessible-name.doc: AccessKit name (`Response::accessible_name`); inputs default to their hint or text.

align-self.doc: Cross-axis alignment in the parent box, overriding its `align-items`.

anchor.doc: A name unique in its embedded root: the node's egui id derives from it (stable across runs, not only across reorders), it is the AccessKit author id, and `Embed::anchor_rect` finds it. Changing it drops the node's egui memory.

anchor-scope.doc: Set by the runtime on the top nodes of a keyed `{#each}` item: the item's key, and the keys of the keyed items around it (outermost first, separated by U+001F). An `anchor` inside it takes its egui id from these keys and the anchors of its anchored ancestors, so repeated anchors in a keyed list get one id per row; `key=` selectors match it. Not for apps to set.

autofocus.doc: Takes keyboard focus when it first appears (in a `dialog` scope: when the dialog opens).

bottom.doc: Inset from the containing block's bottom edge in points; null for auto.

dialog-role.doc: Its place in a `dialog-buttons` row (QDialogButtonBox roles): `accept`, `reject`, `destructive`, `apply`, `reset`, `help`, `action`; `auto` is `accept` for a `default` button, `reject` for a `cancel` one, else `action`. Also the `[dialog-role=…]` selector.

drag-data.doc: The drag payload's data (JSON for structured data); `drop` delivers it.

drag-type.doc: Makes the node a drag source: the payload's type, a MIME-like string (`cad/part`); empty for none.

drop-types.doc: Makes the node a drop target: the drag types it accepts, separated by spaces or commas (`*` any, `cad/*` a prefix); empty for none.

enabled.doc: Takes input when true; drawn greyed out otherwise (`Ui::add_enabled`).

flex-basis.doc: Main-axis size before growing or shrinking; null for auto.

flex-grow.doc: Share of the parent's free main-axis space.

flex-shrink.doc: Share of the parent's main-axis overflow to give up.

height.doc: Height in points; null for auto.

invalid.doc: Marks the value as invalid: an outline in the error colour (`Visuals::error_fg_color`) and AccessKit `invalid`. The app sets it; the widget never does.

left.doc: Inset from the containing block's left edge in points (`position: absolute` or `relative`); null for auto.

margin.doc: Outer spacing on all four sides, in points.

max-height.doc: Maximum height in points; null for none.

max-width.doc: Maximum width in points; null for none.

min-height.doc: Minimum height in points; null for auto.

min-width.doc: Minimum width in points; null for auto.

position.doc: `absolute` takes the node out of the flow and places it by `left`/`top`/`right`/`bottom` inside its containing block: the nearest `relative` or `absolute` ancestor, else the root.

right.doc: Inset from the containing block's right edge in points; null for auto.

source-loc.doc: Set by the runtime in dev builds: where the node was declared, as `file#offset` (the template element's byte offset in its `.svelte` file), then the component call sites it renders inside, innermost first, separated by U+001F. The visual designer and the inspector map a node to its source with it (`NodeRef::source_loc`, `source=` selectors). Not for apps to set.

status-section.doc: Its place in a `status-bar` (QStatusBar): `temporary` (after the start sections; hidden while a message or status tip shows), `start` (permanent, at the start), `end` (permanent, pushed to the end). Also the `[status-section=…]` selector.

status-tip.doc: Text for the status bar while the pointer is over the node (enabled or not; the innermost node with one wins) or, with nothing hovered, while it has keyboard focus: every `status-bar` of the viewport shows it in `::part(message)`, and `svelters_egui::status_tip` reads it. Empty for none.

top.doc: Inset from the containing block's top edge in points; null for auto.

visible.doc: Shown and laid out when true (`display: none` otherwise).

width.doc: Width in points; null for auto.

animationend.doc: A native animation (TR2) finished; carries its id. The runtime listens to it itself.
animationend.name: animationend

click.doc: The primary button was pressed and released; targets the innermost node that holds both points (EV1). `preventDefault` keeps the click from the widget.
click.name: click

contextmenu.doc: The secondary button went down (EV1), after `pointerdown`. `preventDefault` keeps the press from egui (no context menu).
contextmenu.name: contextmenu

dblclick.doc: A second click on the same node in a short time, after its `click` (EV1).
dblclick.name: dblclick

drag-begin.doc: Drag source: the user started dragging this node (`drag-type` set).
drag-begin.name: drag-begin

drag-end.doc: Drag source: the drag ended; `dropped` is true when a target took it, `action` how (`move`, `copy`, `link`; `none` when not dropped).
drag-end.name: drag-end

drag-enter.doc: Drop target: a drag it accepts entered it (`drop-types` set); carries the drag's type.
drag-enter.name: drag-enter

drag-leave.doc: Drop target: the drag left, was cancelled, or was dropped here (before `drop`).
drag-leave.name: drag-leave

drop.doc: Drop target: a drag it accepts was released over it; carries the type, the data, the point in the node's own points and the drop action from the modifiers (`move`; `copy` with Ctrl, Option on macOS; `link` with Ctrl+Shift, Cmd+Option on macOS). Files dragged in from the OS arrive as `text/uri-list` (one `file://` URI per line) with `copy` on a target that accepts that type.
drop.name: drop

focusin.doc: This node or a descendant took keyboard focus (EV1; after the frame that moved it). `related` is the node that lost it, 0 for none.
focusin.name: focusin

focusout.doc: This node or a descendant lost keyboard focus (EV1). `related` is the node that took it, 0 for none.
focusout.name: focusout

keydown.doc: A key went down while this node or a descendant had focus (EV1); `key` is egui's key name. `preventDefault` keeps the key (and the text it types) from the focused widget.
keydown.name: keydown

keyup.doc: A key went up while this node or a descendant had focus (EV1).
keyup.name: keyup

pointerdown.doc: A pointer button went down over this node or a descendant (EV1: capture, target, bubble). `preventDefault` keeps the press from egui (no click, drag or focus).
pointerdown.name: pointerdown

pointermove.doc: The pointer moved over this node or a descendant (EV1 propagation; CV1): one per frame at the last point, `button` -1, `buttons` the held ones, `offsetX`/`offsetY` relative to the target. Not cancelable: egui always sees the move.
pointermove.name: pointermove

pointerup.doc: A pointer button went up over this node or a descendant (EV1). `preventDefault` cancels the click.
pointerup.name: pointerup

wheel.doc: The mouse wheel or a trackpad scrolled over this node (EV1); `dx`, `dy` in points. `preventDefault` keeps it from scrolling.
wheel.name: wheel

Window.doc: A native window (the root viewport, or an immediate viewport); its children are laid out as a flex column.

close.doc: Closes the window as the user would (no close-request).

present.doc: Shows the window (the first one presented is the root viewport).

gap.doc: Space between the window's children, in points.

padding.doc: Inner spacing of the content area, in points.

source-loc.doc: Set by the runtime in dev builds: where the window was declared (`file#offset`, then the component call sites around it, U+001F-separated). Not for apps to set.

click.doc: The primary button was pressed and released; targets the innermost node that holds both points (EV1). `preventDefault` keeps the click from the widget.
click.name: click

close-request.doc: The user asked to close the window; return true to keep it open. Runs before the frame's pass.
close-request.name: close-request

contextmenu.doc: The secondary button went down (EV1), after `pointerdown`. `preventDefault` keeps the press from egui (no context menu).
contextmenu.name: contextmenu

dblclick.doc: A second click on the same node in a short time, after its `click` (EV1).
dblclick.name: dblclick

focusin.doc: This node or a descendant took keyboard focus (EV1; after the frame that moved it). `related` is the node that lost it, 0 for none.
focusin.name: focusin

focusout.doc: This node or a descendant lost keyboard focus (EV1). `related` is the node that took it, 0 for none.
focusout.name: focusout

keydown.doc: A key went down while this node or a descendant had focus (EV1); `key` is egui's key name. `preventDefault` keeps the key (and the text it types) from the focused widget.
keydown.name: keydown

keyup.doc: A key went up while this node or a descendant had focus (EV1).
keyup.name: keyup

pointerdown.doc: A pointer button went down over this node or a descendant (EV1: capture, target, bubble). `preventDefault` keeps the press from egui (no click, drag or focus).
pointerdown.name: pointerdown

pointermove.doc: The pointer moved over this node or a descendant (EV1 propagation; CV1): one per frame at the last point, `button` -1, `buttons` the held ones, `offsetX`/`offsetY` relative to the target. Not cancelable: egui always sees the move.
pointermove.name: pointermove

pointerup.doc: A pointer button went up over this node or a descendant (EV1). `preventDefault` cancels the click.
pointerup.name: pointerup

wheel.doc: The mouse wheel or a trackpad scrolled over this node (EV1); `dx`, `dy` in points. `preventDefault` keeps it from scrolling.
wheel.name: wheel

px.provenance: skelter points: 1px in a style sheet is one device-independent point
